title: Shattered Bear Portrait
description: A majestic black bear with glowing golden eyes stares directly forward, its face and body intersected by a network of broken glass shards. Golden flowers and green foliage emerge from the cracks, while ornate blue fabric with gold embroidery drapes across its shoulders against a misty green and purple background with radiating light beams.
prompt: A majestic black bear with one glowing golden eye stares forward, its head and torso fractured by a web of broken glass shards with golden leaf details. Yellow wildflowers and green foliage grow through the cracks. Ornate dark blue and teal fabric with intricate gold embroidery drapes over its shoulders. Misty green and purple background with dramatic radiating light beams breaking through the shattered glass.
